modules.name: Chop screen (core)
modules.desc: Shared part of the chop options: chop screen (TRIM > ZONE > F3), F5 APPLY, F6 PLAY, TRIM pad select. Added by Chop: even split and/or Lazy chop.

modules.name: Chop: even split
modules.desc: TRIM > ZONE, press F3 again: chop screen with the waveform; F3 picks 16 / 8 / 4 even slices, F5 APPLY makes the sounds and a drum program. Pads and F6 PLAY preview slices; TRIM pads select their sound.

modules.name: Lazy chop
modules.desc: Chop screen LAZY mode: hit a pad to play the sound, tap new pads where slices start, F4 UNDO, F5 APPLY makes the sounds and a drum program.

modules.name: Program MONO
modules.desc: Pads set to Voice overlap MONO choke each other (newer-MPC style): ALL > MONO makes the whole program mono. A single MONO pad works as stock.

modules.name: 1/4 timing
modules.desc: Timing / Note value: OFF, 1/4, 1/4(3), 1/8 ... 1/32(3) (nothing removed). .ALL files stay safe on stock units: they read 1/4 as 1/8 and 1/4(3) as 1/8(3).

modules.name: Mute group for bank / program
modules.desc: PROGRAM > ASSIGN, cursor on Mode:, WINDOW: vubeatz ALL FOR window copies the pad Mode (MUTE n, NORMAL ...) to the bank or the whole program.

modules.name: Fast waveform
modules.desc: TRIM / LOOP / ZONE / chop waveform appears up to ~10x sooner on long sounds (examines every Nth sample, same picture within 1-2 pixels).

modules.name: Start at 0 after sampling
modules.desc: A new recording opens in TRIM with St: 0 whatever Pre-rec is set to (stock puts St at the Pre-rec point, 4410 for 100 ms). The pre-recorded audio stays in the sound.

modules.name: Mute groups 1-8
modules.desc: MODE field accepts MUTE 5-8 as well (adds to Mute groups 1-4)

modules.name: Sampling Mode (SP1200 / S900)
modules.desc: SAMPLE page > Mode field > WINDOW: SP1200 / S900 presets or a custom 8000-44100 Hz rate for new recordings. Shows the processing box, then KEEP / RETRY at once.

modules.name: OS date Oct. 11,2026
modules.desc: Date line on OTHER > VER. and the date stamp of a Copy Operating System file

modules.name: Dark mode (inverted LCD)
modules.desc: Every LCD pixel byte is inverted inside the screen refresh loops. Touches the refresh path: emulator-tested only
